conditions.note: A knock rings down with a time constant of a few seconds; it can also displace the beam.

conditions.description: The beam is coupled into the fiber core
conditions.note: Thermal drift of the table walks the beam off the core by a few tenths of a milliradian per hour. Below 0.1 mW no light reaches the fiber: look upstream.

conditions.description: The camera images the fiber output within its linear range
conditions.note: Full scale is 4095 counts; the peak is kept between about 35 % and 90 % of it.

conditions.description: The dark level at the present exposure is known
conditions.note: Dark current doubles about every 6 K of sensor temperature, and the sensor warms after start; a new exposure needs a new dark level.

knock.description: The table was knocked or a door slammed: it rings, and the beam may move

enclosure_opened.description: Air currents and a temperature step move the beam for several minutes

fiber_reconnected.description: A reconnected fiber changes the coupling

laser_restarted.description: The laser was switched off and on again: it warms up anew
